item.title: New York officials respond to war with Iran
item.description: U.S. military leadership said this past weekend's strikes on Iran was not a single, overnight operation. The state of New York's security concerns are carrying over into the work week as growing economic concerns are mounting as well.

item.title: Whitesboro edges Skaneateles for Section III Division II Title
item.description: Monday night was section championship night for Section III ice hockey at the Upstate Medical Center. For the first time since 2010, a sectional banner will be traveling from the Upstate Medical Center to the Mohawk Valley.

item.title: Trebilcock charged with attempted murder in Albany
item.description: A man has been charged with attempted murder after a violent assault took place at the Capital District Psychiatric Center in Albany. The incident involved two patients.

item.title: State lawmakers continued to discuss NYSERDA memo
item.description: New Yorkers from around the state still had questions on Tuesday following last week's New York State Energy Research and Development Authority's (NYSERDA) memo release. The circulated memo made plainly the potential energy utility cost increases that New Yorkers could face if the 2019 Climate Leadership & Community Protection Act (CLCPA) continued as is.
